r2_delivery_hotfix.failure: BP-070 fixture imported miniquake.byteio as bio but called nonexistent uppercase C-style members
r2_delivery_hotfix.status: FAIL at BP-071 fixture 10; superseded by R3

r3_delivery_hotfix.failure: BP-071 shareware loose-subdirectory fixture left FileSystem.staticRegistered at its startup value true
r3_delivery_hotfix.fix: fixture explicitly enters the post-COM_CheckRegistered shareware state before resolving a loose subdirectory path
r3_delivery_hotfix.status: Windows test reached result collection; collector failed on synthetic build fixture; superseded by R4

r4_delivery_hotfix.failure: COLLECT_RESULTS.ps1 rejected build\bp071_fs\id1\latin.txt as id1 content
r4_delivery_hotfix.root_cause: the BP-071/BP-072 runtime suites intentionally create synthetic id1 trees under build; the collector applied its strict source-data rule to ephemeral test artifacts
r4_delivery_hotfix.fix: skip and record synthetic/game-data-shaped build artifacts while preserving strict rejection for source/docs inputs
r4_delivery_hotfix.status: Windows run reached BP-073; model fixture and collector failed; superseded by R5

r5_delivery_hotfix.failure: BP-073 expected a texture name in the numeric animation metadata table; R4 collector raised a Windows PowerShell 5.1 ArgumentException
r5_delivery_hotfix.root_cause: fixture confused BspTexture.name with sequenceTextureAnimations metadata; collector converted a generic List[object] through @($SkippedBuildArtifacts)
r5_delivery_hotfix.fix: assert the base texture name separately, bind anim_total=4, and serialize skipped artifacts from a native object array
